answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one copper weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The glacier report makes public the merge explicitly at each ledge. Because of that, someone who spins up 123 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 285 times the capital for one share. A farm of 2604 identities would post 772 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
